name: 93908 · Salinas, CA
findings: ZIP 93908 (Salinas) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93908 (Salinas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93908 (Salinas) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).
